remarks: Discover the perfect blend of charm, space, and convenience in this in-town Colonial offering 4+ bedrooms and 2 full baths. The second floor features four generously sized bedrooms, two with private balconies, while the main level provides exceptional flexibility with a possible fifth bedroom and dedicated office space. A finished third-floor bonus area adds even more room for recreation, guests, or a quiet retreat. Ideally located just moments from the Metro-North train, vibrant shopping, and popular restaurants, this home places everyday conveniences at your doorstep. Enjoy direct access to scenic Mead Park right across the street, complete with tranquil water views, and benefit from easy connectivity to the Merritt Parkway for effortless commuting. Experience comfortable living in a prime New Canaan location and take full advantage of all this sought-after community has to offer.
